html:
SMTO-MEM-0014 — SMTO couldn't find any text to search in this file

GUID: 5c758f37-ce07-5530-8124-07945756a458
Slug: knowledge-document-has-no-content
Domain: MEM · Subsystem: knowledge

What happened

  • The file was uploaded, but SMTO found no readable text in it, so nothing from it can be searched or used in answers. This often happens with blank files or with unclear scans and photos.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In Knowledge, select Preview on the document to see what SMTO could read from it. An empty preview confirms SMTO found no text, rather than some other problem.
  2. Open the file on your computer and check it contains real text. For a scan or photo, use a sharper, straight, well-lit copy, or export a version with selectable text. SMTO reads scans with built-in text recognition, which needs clear images of the text.
  3. If the text isn't in English, open Document settings and add its language code to OCR languages (for example eng+deu for English and German), then save. Text recognition only reads the languages it is set to look for.
  4. On the document, select Manage, then Replace and choose the improved file, or Reindex if you only changed the language. This runs indexing again with the new file or setting.

What success looks like

  • The document shows Ready to search and lists one or more passages.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO, with the file if it is safe to share. Keep your original file; SMTO stored it but couldn't find text in it.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Indexing failed with document_has_no_content: extraction completed but chunking produced zero passages, so no search index was built for the document.

What this means

  • The file was accepted, but extraction produced no passages that search can use. The original operation and completed work retain their own recorded outcomes; this diagnostic does not replay them.

Why this can happen

  • The component reported document_has_no_content. This does not establish the outcome of unrelated operations.

How to diagnose it

  • Preview shows extracted passages.
  • Inspect the error reference and the affected component’s current observation before selecting a recovery action.

How to fix it

  • Open the document's Preview to see the extracted blocks and warnings. Supply a file with selectable text, or a clearer scan with the correct OCR languages set in Knowledge Document settings, then use Replace or Reindex on the document.
  • Preview the source locally. Use a file containing selectable text or a clear supported image, then replace this source.

Retry and execution caution

  • Preview shows extracted passages.

How to verify the fix

  • Preview shows extracted passages.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained task data or repeat an operation with an unknown outcome.

Technical notes

  • Status checks do not replay tasks or modify source documents.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
